# Supplier Exit and Offboarding

## Purpose

Reduce security, data, continuity, and dependency risk when a supplier
relationship ends or materially changes.

## Exit requirements

A material supplier exit SHOULD address:

- access revocation;
- credential and integration cleanup;
- data return, migration, or verified deletion where applicable;
- retained-record obligations;
- replacement or continuity plan;
- domain, certificate, key, or webhook dependencies;
- outstanding incidents or contractual issues;
- confirmation of completion.

## Planning

High-dependency suppliers should have an exit strategy before an emergency
forces one.

See [Supplier Offboarding SOP](../sop/SUPPLIER_OFFBOARDING_SOP.md).
